info.title: Crystal-Clear API
info.description: API for analyzing Ethereum smart contracts

post.summary: Transaction risk: from raw signed tx
post.description: Decode a raw signed transaction, simulate via trace_call, list all touched contracts, and assess risk similarly to other endpoints.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable explanation of what went wrong

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned for 4xx/5xx responses.

sender_address.title: Sender Address
sender_address.description: The 0x-hex address of the sender. Required if 'raw_tx' is an unsigned transaction. Ignored if 'raw_tx' is a signed transaction.

latest_offset.title: Latest Offset
latest_offset.description: Limit first-time checks to N latest blocks (performance control)

from_block.title: From Block
from_block.description: Lower bound block for first-time checks

to_block.title: To Block
to_block.description: Upper bound block for first-time checks

interaction_type.title: Interaction Type
interaction_type.description: Specific interaction type to evaluate. If omitted, all applicable types are used.

RawTxRiskRequest.title: RawTxRiskRequest
RawTxRiskRequest.description: Request model for raw signed transaction risk check.

status.title: Status
status.description: Overall risk verdict. OK = no issues found; DANGEROUS = at least one first-time or unverified contract interaction; POTENTIAL_DANGEROUS = scan data is incomplete so risk cannot be ruled out.

interaction_status.title: Interaction Status
interaction_status.description: Per-interaction-type risk status. Each key is an interaction type and its value is one of: ok, dangerous, potential_dangerous, or not_checked.

details.title: Details
details.description: Per-contract breakdown of risk signals for every address touched by the transaction

dangerous_interaction_types.title: Dangerous Interaction Types
dangerous_interaction_types.description: Interaction types that triggered the DANGEROUS verdict (e.g. ["contract_direct"]). Null when status is OK.

danger_reason.title: Danger Reason
danger_reason.description: Root cause of a non-OK verdict. FIRST_TIME_INTERACTION = sender/contract has never called this address; MISSING_HISTORY = no historical scan data available; UNVERIFIED = contract source code is not verified on-chain.

SimulationResponse.title: SimulationResponse
SimulationResponse.description: Aggregated risk verdict for a simulated or decoded transaction.

address.title: Address
address.description: Checksummed Ethereum address of the touched contract

first_time.title: First Time
first_time.description: True if the sender has never interacted with this contract across any of the checked interaction types

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Source-code verification status from Etherscan/Sourcify (e.g. {"verification": "verified", "compiler": "solc", ...}). Null when verification data is unavailable.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Call depth at which this contract was reached during trace simulation (0 = direct target, 1+ = internal/delegate call)

types.title: Types
types.description: Map of EVM call types to their frequency for this address (e.g. {"CALL": 2, "DELEGATECALL": 1})

interaction_first_time.title: Interaction First Time
interaction_first_time.description: Per-interaction-type first-time flag. Keys are interaction types (sender_direct, sender_transitive, contract_direct, contract_transitive); values are true if this is the first recorded interaction of that type.

interaction_state.title: Interaction State
interaction_state.description: Per-interaction-type data availability. FOUND means historical scan data exists; MISSING means no scan data is available and the result is best-effort.

SimulationResultItem.title: SimulationResultItem
SimulationResultItem.description: Risk analysis result for a single contract touched during the transaction.
